events.title: "Imagine" Album Turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album "Imagine" was released in the UK on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Enduring Message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years ago, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine' – an album that still speaks volumes today. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Sting Turns 75
events.blurb: British music legend Sting, known for his work with The Police and as a solo artist, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Sting's Diverse Career
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to Sting! From The Police to his incredible solo career, which Sting era is your favourite?

events.title: 25 Years Since iPod's Debut
events.blurb: While officially announced later in October and released for sale in November 2001, Apple's revolutionary first iPod began its journey to change how we listen to music 25 years ago this autumn.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember life before the iPod? 25 years ago, Apple started a revolution in how we carry our music. What was on your first iPod?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the premiere of the first 007 film, "Dr. No," in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! We're celebrating 007's enduring legacy. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Remembering The Beatles' co-founder John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the enduring music and message of John Lennon. What's your favourite Lennon track?

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Cleese's Comedy
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your most loved moment?

events.title: "White Album" Anniversary Approaches
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, famously known as the "White Album," was originally released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: The White Album's Impact
angles.copy: Approaching the anniversary of The Beatles' 'White Album' – a truly groundbreaking record. What's your standout track from this double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen frontman, the incomparable Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-five years on, we remember the legendary Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: "Rubber Soul" Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album "Rubber Soul" was released in the UK on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Influence
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul' – an album that changed everything. What's the track that still gets you?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of The Beatles' John Lennon in New York City.

angles.name: Lennon's Peace Message
angles.copy: On the anniversary of his passing, we reflect on the profound impact of John Lennon. His message of peace and love resonates as strongly as ever.

events.title: David Bowie Would Have Been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic musician and artist David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's Artistry
angles.copy: On what would have been his 80th birthday, we celebrate the unparalleled artistry of David Bowie. Which of his many personas is your favourite?

events.title: Elvis Presley Would Have Been 92
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: The King's Legacy
angles.copy: Long live the King! On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we honour Elvis Presley. What's your all-time favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page Turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and producer Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Page's Guitar Genius
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the incomparable Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped rock history. What's your favourite Led Zeppelin guitar moment?

events.title: Rod Stewart Turns 82
events.blurb: Iconic British singer-songwriter Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod's Timeless Voice
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the legendary Sir Rod Stewart! His distinctive voice has given us decades of hits. What's your go-to Rod Stewart song?
